title: Lou Baldin's In League with a UFO
summary: Richard Dolan tells of Lou Baldin's In League with a UFO, about 1947; 1997 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So he in the 90s mid 90s he writes a book called In League with a UFO.

plain: Richard Dolan, a historian who writes about UFOs, talks about a man named Lou Baldin. Dolan says that in the mid 1990s Baldin wrote a book called In League with a UFO, telling of his own claimed experiences, with a story that reaches back as far as 1947.
